text: 30年期美债收益率创逾20年新高，日本10年期国债收益率冲上1996年来新高，美股承压横盘，美元原油齐升。 习近平同美国总统特朗普会谈。 报道称美伊探讨分阶段重启霍尔木兹海峡。 胡塞武装袭击不停，马克龙宣布法国将军援沙特、保护红海延布港石油设施。 美债抛售加剧！7年期美债拍卖遇冷，美国财政部回购规模再度低于上限，市政债收益率创15年新高。 美联储三位官员同日放鹰，市场预期10月加息概率升至69%。 美国上周首申失业救济人数降至19.7万人，为1969年以来的最低水平之一。 中国央行：建议发挥增量政策和存量政策集成效应，增强政策前瞻性灵活性针对性。 购房定
text_en: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield hit a more than 20-year high, Japan's 10-year government bond yield surged to its highest since 1996, U.S. stocks came under pressure and traded sideways, while the dollar and crude oil rose together. Xi Jinping held talks with U.S. President Trump. Reports say the U.S. and Iran are discussing a phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Houthi attacks continue, and Macron announced that France will provide military aid to Saudi Arabia and protect oil facilities at the Red Sea port of Yanbu. U.S. Treasury selling intensified! The 7-year Treasury auction saw weak demand, the U.S. Treasury's buyback size again fell below its cap, and municipal bond yields hit a 15-year high. Three Fed officials took a hawkish stance on the same day, and market expectations for an October rate hike rose to 69%. U.S. initial jobless claims fell to 197,000 last week, one of the lowest levels since 1969. PBOC: It is recommended to leverage the integrated effects of incremental and existing policies and enhance the forward-looking, flexible and targeted nature of policy. Home purchase deposit
